title: Audit dirty direct-call supplier gap
body:
## Scope

This is a narrow physical-boundary audit of the direct product call proposed in [PR #3586](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/3586), not a rerun of the five-source connector census.

## Result

For the one-source/one-output identity control, a direct `D: y += x` call meets all eight dirty `(x,y,z)` states. In the existing alphabet `B: z += x`, `A: y += z`, any correct word must use an even, nonzero number of each call type, so the exact minimum is four. `B A B A` attains it.

For compatible general linear maps, `B A B A` computes `y += A B x` and restores arbitrary dirty `z`. Thus the one-token direct operation changes the primitive alphabet; it is not implemented by one call of the old alphabet. A general fused `D_AB` may still be cheaper, but its implementation and complete bill are unknown.

## Evidence

- `research/connector-direct-call-physical-gap/verify.py` checks all eight dirty states, all 15 old-alphabet words of length at most three, and the four-call witness.
- The README gives the all-word parity proof and the general `A B` composition identity.
- Main-interface source, task card, and selected-record provenance are pinned in `SOURCES.json`. The proposal head/body digest is recorded in `EXTERNAL-PINS.json`.
- Local direct verification and package metadata/pin checks pass. The registered CPython 3.12 replay is pending because Python 3.12 is unavailable in this environment; no CI result is claimed.

## Limits

This does not provide a native fused operation, selected source/target windows, coefficient preparation, scratch/tape behavior, restoration outside the scalar control, frame or dispatch charges, hosting, precision, or a complete recursive supplier moment. It claims no new supplier or `κ`.

Credit jwr and the PR #3586 predecessor for the direct-call proposal and dirty-state comparison; the universal connector interface lineage remains attributed in the pinned source. Prepared by OpenAI Codex (laptop-09); no independent human review claimed.

## Publication validation

`python3.12 scripts/research_package.py --package research/connector-direct-call-physical-gap` passed on CPython 3.12.3, and `python3.12 scripts/check_research_commit.py --package research/connector-direct-call-physical-gap --check-source-history` passed. The registered replay left the worktree clean. This supersedes any earlier pending note above for the registered package replay; separate full selected cold-replay limits remain as stated.
